response.text:
{
  "tokens": {
    "colors": {
      "background": "#16211a",
      "surface": "#1f2d24",
      "text": "#ede9dc",
      "muted": "#a9b3a5",
      "primary": "#e9c43f",
      "onPrimary": "#16211a",
      "accent": "#e9c43f",
      "border": "#34463a",
      "inverse": "#ede9dc",
      "onInverse": "#16211a",
      "band": "#e9c43f",
      "onBand": "#16211a"
    },
    "pairing": "fraunces-source-sans",
    "radius": 2,
    "headingWeight": 800,
    "headingCase": "normal",
    "density": "regular",
    "wordmark": "plain"
  },
  "sections": [
    {
      "intent": "hero",
      "tone": "default",
      "copy": {
        "headline": "Sir iz hleva za vogalom",
        "lead": "Iz mleka naših 30 krav vsak dan izdelujemo sir. V trgovinici na kmetiji v Lancovem vas čakajo sir, skuta, jogurt, sirotka, maslo in darilni paketi."
      },
      "props": {
        "intent": "hero",
        "width": "contained",
        "minHeight": "l",
        "rows": 6,
        "gap": 3,
        "headerOver": true,
        "elements": [
          {
            "id": "e_hero_wheel",
            "kind": "decor",
            "desk": { "col": 9, "span": 4, "row": 1, "rowSpan": 6, "alignY": "center", "bleedX": "end" },
            "phone": { "order": 0, "span": "inset", "alignX": "center" },
            "svg": {
              "width": 200,
              "height": 200,
              "paths": [
                { "d": "M100,100 L190,100 A90,90 0 1,1 145,22 Z", "fill": "none", "stroke": "primary", "width": 2 }
              ]
            },
            "color": "primary",
            "fit": "cell"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_hero_h1",
            "kind": "heading",
            "desk": { "col": 1, "span": 9, "row": 1, "rowSpan": 3, "alignY": "end" },
            "phone": { "order": 1, "span": "full" },
            "text": "{copy.headline}",
            "level": 1,
            "size": 7,
            "weight": 800,
            "measure": "l",
            "color": "primary"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_hero_lead",
            "kind": "text",
            "desk": { "col": 1, "span": 6, "row": 4 },
            "phone": { "order": 2, "span": "full" },
            "paragraphs": ["{copy.lead}"],
            "size": 1,
            "color": "text"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_hero_phone",
            "kind": "fact",
            "desk": { "col": 1, "span": 5, "row": 5, "alignY": "start" },
            "phone": { "order": 3, "span": "full" },
            "value": "{business.phone}",
            "label": "Pokličite za naročilo",
            "treatment": "numeral",
            "size": 4,
            "link": { "action": "call" },
            "labelAt": "before",
            "color": "primary"
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "intent": "story",
      "tone": "band",
      "copy": {
        "headline": "Od hleva do kotla je 20 metrov",
        "lead": "Mleko pri nas ne potuje nikamor. Sir nastane tam, kjer se krave pasejo in molzejo."
      },
      "props": {
        "intent": "story",
        "width": "full",
        "rows": 4,
        "gap": 3,
        "elements": [
          {
            "id": "e_story_h",
            "kind": "heading",
            "desk": { "col": 1, "span": 5, "row": 1, "rowSpan": 4, "alignY": "start" },
            "phone": { "order": 1, "span": "full" },
            "text": "{copy.headline}",
            "level": 2,
            "size": 5,
            "weight": 800,
            "measure": "m",
            "color": "onBand"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_story_rule",
            "kind": "decor",
            "desk": { "col": 6, "span": 7, "row": 1, "rowSpan": 2, "alignY": "center" },
            "phone": { "order": 0, "span": "full" },
            "svg": {
              "width": 400,
              "height": 80,
              "paths": [
                { "d": "M30,50 L370,50", "fill": "none", "stroke": "onBand", "width": 2 },
                { "d": "M30,42V58 M47,44V56 M64,44V56 M81,44V56 M98,44V56 M115,42V58 M132,44V56 M149,44V56 M166,44V56 M183,44V56 M200,42V58 M217,44V56 M234,44V56 M251,44V56 M268,44V56 M285,42V58 M302,44V56 M319,44V56 M336,44V56 M353,44V56 M370,42V58", "fill": "none", "stroke": "onBand", "width": 2 },
                { "d": "M14,24 L14,42 L46,42 L46,24 M12,24 L30,8 L48,24", "fill": "none", "stroke": "onBand", "width": 2 },
                { "d": "M341,28 A14,14 0 0,0 369,28 L341,28 M349,42 L349,48 M361,42 L361,48", "fill": "none", "stroke": "onBand", "width": 2 }
              ]
            },
            "color": "onBand",
            "fit": "cell"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_story_text",
            "kind": "text",
            "desk": { "col": 6, "span": 5, "row": 3, "rowSpan": 2 },
            "phone": { "order": 2, "span": "full" },
            "paragraphs": ["{brief.highlights[1]}", "{copy.lead}"],
            "size": 1,
            "color": "onBand"
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "intent": "products",
      "tone": "default",
      "copy": {
        "headline": "Iz mleka naših krav",
        "lead": "Vse, kar je v trgovinici, nastane na kmetiji."
      },
      "props": {
        "intent": "products",
        "width": "full",
        "rows": 1,
        "gap": 2,
        "elements": [
          {
            "id": "e_ribbon",
            "kind": "ribbon",
            "desk": { "col": 1, "span": 12, "row": 1, "bleedX": "both" },
            "phone": { "order": 0, "span": "bleed" },
            "items": [
              "{brief.offerings[1].name}",
              "{brief.offerings[2].name}",
              "{brief.offerings[3].name}",
              "{brief.offerings[4].name}",
              "{brief.offerings[5].name}",
              "{brief.offerings[6].name}"
            ],
            "move": "loop",
            "color": "muted"
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "intent": "prices",
      "tone": "alt",
      "copy": {
        "headline": "Iz naše trgovinice",
        "lead": "Vse delamo iz mleka lastnih krav, na kmetiji v Lancovem."
      },
      "props": {
        "intent": "prices",
        "width": "contained",
        "rows": 5,
        "gap": 3,
        "elements": [
          {
            "id": "e_shop_h",
            "kind": "heading",
            "desk": { "col": 1, "span": 6, "row": 1 },
            "phone": { "order": 0, "span": "full" },
            "text": "{copy.headline}",
            "level": 2,
            "size": 4,
            "weight": 800,
            "measure": "m",
            "color": "text"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_shop_lead",
            "kind": "text",
            "desk": { "col": 7, "span": 5, "row": 1, "alignY": "end" },
            "phone": { "order": 1, "span": "full" },
            "paragraphs": ["{copy.lead}"],
            "size": 0,
            "color": "muted"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_shop_prices",
            "kind": "prices",
            "desk": { "col": 1, "span": 7, "row": 2, "rowSpan": 4 },
            "phone": { "order": 2, "span": "full" },
            "items": [
              { "name": "{brief.offerings[0].name}", "price": { "amount": 18, "unit": "/ kg" } },
              { "name": "{brief.offerings[1].name}", "price": { "amount": 21, "unit": "/ kg" } },
              { "name": "{brief.offerings[2].name}", "price": { "amount": 7, "unit": "/ kg" } },
              { "name": "{brief.offerings[3].name}", "price": { "$placeholder": "price", "note": "Cena jogurta" } },
              { "name": "{brief.offerings[4].name}", "price": { "$placeholder": "price", "note": "Cena sirotke" } },
              { "name": "{brief.offerings[5].name}", "price": { "$placeholder": "price", "note": "Cena masla" } },
              { "name": "{brief.offerings[6].name}", "price": { "$placeholder": "price", "note": "Cena darilnega paketa" } }
            ],
            "style": "rows",
            "size": 1,
            "color": "text"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_tour_h",
            "kind": "heading",
            "desk": { "col": 9, "span": 4, "row": 2, "rowSpan": 2, "alignY": "end" },
            "phone": { "order": 3, "span": "full" },
            "text": "{brief.offerings[7].name}",
            "level": 3,
            "size": 3,
            "weight": 700,
            "measure": "m",
            "color": "primary"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_tour_price",
            "kind": "fact",
            "desk": { "col": 9, "span": 4, "row": 4, "rowSpan": 2, "alignY": "start" },
            "phone": { "order": 4, "span": "full" },
            "value": "{brief.priced[3].price}",
            "label": "Za skupine, po dogovoru",
            "treatment": "tag",
            "size": 3,
            "labelAt": "after",
            "color": "onPrimary",
            "fill": "primary"
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "intent": "hours",
      "tone": "default",
      "copy": {
        "headline": "Kdaj nas obiščete",
        "lead": "Trgovinica je na kmetiji v Lancovem."
      },
      "props": {
        "intent": "hours",
        "width": "contained",
        "rows": 3,
        "gap": 3,
        "elements": [
          {
            "id": "e_hours_h",
            "kind": "heading",
            "desk": { "col": 1, "span": 5, "row": 1 },
            "phone": { "order": 0, "span": "full" },
            "text": "{copy.headline}",
            "level": 2,
            "size": 4,
            "weight": 800,
            "measure": "m",
            "color": "text"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_hours_week",
            "kind": "hours",
            "desk": { "col": 1, "span": 8, "row": 2, "rowSpan": 2 },
            "phone": { "order": 1, "span": "full" },
            "style": "week",
            "color": "text"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_hours_note",
            "kind": "text",
            "desk": { "col": 9, "span": 4, "row": 2 },
            "phone": { "order": 2, "span": "full" },
            "paragraphs": ["{business.hours.note}"],
            "size": 0,
            "color": "muted"
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "intent": "contact",
      "tone": "band",
      "copy": {
        "headline": "Pokličite za naročilo ali ogled",
        "lead": "Za skupine pripravimo ogled sirarne s pokušino. Najava vsaj tri dni prej."
      },
      "props": {
        "intent": "contact",
        "width": "full",
        "rows": 4,
        "gap": 3,
        "elements": [
          {
            "id": "e_contact_h",
            "kind": "heading",
            "desk": { "col": 1, "span": 6, "row": 1 },
            "phone": { "order": 0, "span": "full" },
            "text": "{copy.headline}",
            "level": 2,
            "size": 4,
            "weight": 800,
            "measure": "m",
            "color": "onBand"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_contact_phone",
            "kind": "fact",
            "desk": { "col": 1, "span": 8, "row": 2 },
            "phone": { "order": 1, "span": "full" },
            "value": "{business.phone}",
            "label": "Telefon",
            "treatment": "numeral",
            "size": 7,
            "link": { "action": "call" },
            "labelAt": "before",
            "color": "onBand"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_contact_lead",
            "kind": "text",
            "desk": { "col": 5, "span": 4, "row": 3, "rowSpan": 2 },
            "phone": { "order": 2, "span": "full" },
            "paragraphs": ["{copy.lead}"],
            "size": 0,
            "color": "onBand"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_contact_info",
            "kind": "contact",
            "desk": { "col": 1, "span": 4, "row": 3, "rowSpan": 2 },
            "phone": { "order": 3, "span": "full" },
            "show": ["email", "address"],
            "color": "onBand"
          },
          {
            "id": "e_contact_map",
            "kind": "map",
            "desk": { "col": 9, "span": 4, "row": 1, "rowSpan": 4, "alignY": "center" },
            "phone": { "order": 4, "span": "full" },
            "style": "pin",
            "color": "onBand"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
